get.description: The bell and the Notifications page: your newest 100 history notifications plus all pending follow requests, newest first. Kinds: `follow` (started following you), `follow_request` (asked to follow your followers-only or private profile; accept with `POST /api/me/follow-requests/{user}/accept`, decline with `DELETE /api/me/follow-requests/{user}`), `follow_accepted`, `room_invite`, `room_joined` (someone you invited joined), `room_deleted` (a room you were in was deleted; opens `/rooms`; when staff deleted it, it is from the WatchWise team, id 0, and never names the staff member) and `room_removed` (to the creator: staff deleted your room; always delivered, no switch; the sentence is "deleted your room" and `to` is `/rooms`), `new_messages` (one per room, counting up until you read the room), `mention` (@yourusername in a room), `night_invite`, `night_rsvp` and `night_vote` (to the host), `night_update` (the host confirmed, cancelled, reopened or moved the night), `review_helpful` and `review_removed` (staff rejected or deleted your review; it has no real actor, so `actor` is the WatchWise team with id 0, the sentence is "removed your review", `film` says which film, `to` opens its page, and it has no setting: it always arrives), `list_restricted` (staff made your list private, removed a film from it or deleted it; also from the WatchWise team, `target` is the list title, the sentence is "made your list private", "removed a film from your list" or "deleted your list", `film` says which film for a removal, `to` opens the list or, once it is deleted, `/lists`; no setting, it always arrives), `message_removed` (staff removed your message in a room; from the WatchWise team like `review_removed`, the sentence is "removed your message in", `target` is the room name, `film` says which film and `to` opens `/rooms/{id}`; never the message text or who acted; always arrives), `room_locked` / `room_unlocked` (to the room's creator: staff locked or unlocked their room; from the WatchWise team, the sentences are "locked your room" and "unlocked your room", no staff identity, always arrive) and `profile_changed` (staff removed your profile picture or your bio; also from the WatchWise team with no real actor, the sentence is "removed your profile picture" or "removed your bio", `to` opens `/settings`, and it has no setting: it always arrives). New ones are pushed over the private channel `notifications.{your id}` (authorize with `POST /api/notifications/socket-auth`): `notification.pushed` carries `{notification, silent}` (silent ones update the list without a pop-up), `notifications.changed` means reload. Room read receipts are never listed.

patch.summary: Mark a notification read or unread

422.description: `read` is missing or not a boolean.

delete.description: Deletes it. Dismissing a `follow_request` declines the request.

post.description: Pusher-protocol authorization on Reverb (connection settings come from `GET /api/chat/connection`) for `private-notifications.{your id}`.

Notification.description: Shown as: **actor** `text` **target**, with `detail` (a quote) and `film` (look its title up) underneath. For `review_removed`, `list_restricted`, `message_removed`, `room_locked`, `room_unlocked` and `profile_changed` the actor is the WatchWise team (id 0, username `watchwise`, name `WatchWise`, no avatar), never the staff member; so it is for `room_removed` and for a `room_deleted` that staff caused.

actor_followed.description: You follow the actor (drives Follow back).

actor_requested.description: You asked to follow the actor and they haven't answered.
